findings.status: CONFIRMED product bug - REPORTED, not fixed (out of Stage-4 scope; PM to open the issue)
findings.title: daily_sweep scans watch candidates whose credit_day is intentionally NULL, then aborts the whole sweep
evidence: src/views/watch.py:131 - the candidate INSERT omits credit_day; candidates are watch_state='watching' with credit_day NULL by design
src/alerts.py:13 - SELECT id, company, start_date, tenure_months, credit_day, status FROM bonds ORDER BY id has NO watch_state filter
src/alerts.py:18 - validate_credit_day(NULL) raises ERR-credit-sweep; the loop raises on the first bad row, so no other bond is evaluated
every other consumer filters watch_state='holding' (lock.py:21, grid.py:31, history.py:43, summary.py:50, queries/detail.py:44)
sqlite: a NULL CHECK result passes, so 'credit_day INTEGER CHECK (credit_day >= 1 AND credit_day <= 31)' does not block the row (0 is rejected, NULL is accepted)
device: every app start appends WARN alerts 'daily sweep failed: ERR-credit-sweep: bond 1: credit_day must be an integer in 1-31: None'
the forms are NOT at fault: forms.py:29 _credit_value does int(raw), and watch.py:198-206 the move handler requires an integer credit_day

limitations: no adb bridge and no root: waydroid shell / waydroid logcat are unavailable, so TC-AND-03 (run-as) and the TC-AND-04 cleartext-logcat assertion are covered by static contracts + render evidence instead

no 'am force-stop': TC-AND-07 uses a full container restart (waydroid session stop/start), which does kill the app process (the Notifications badge grew across the restart), as the force-kill equivalent
the GNOME session blanks after 300s idle; the smoke script runs under systemd-inhibit --what=idle and dismisses any lock shield before each capture
device tests stay LOCAL (no CI device runner), per the stage plan non-goals
